headline: Still bad after the short-report change: plain Haiku 5.5 passes 7 of 8 runs and Haiku with the scanner 7 of 8 (A fails dcf-01 r2 on one decoy, B on one unlisted line in the same case), and B costs 84% more tokens (2.36M -> 4.34M, higher in 8 of 8 pairs, 7-10 model turns against 4-6). The short report cut report.md from about 12 KB to 2-4 KB, but not the extra turns: the agents still re-check candidates by hand. Top suggestion: skip the scan below about 2,000 lines and judge the tool only on a large case, where reading every file costs more than reading the report.
